# Interactive Results

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Maps

```{r}
#| label: maps
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Suppress warnings and messages globally
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(highcharter)
library(classInt)

# Interactive mode for maps
tmap_mode("view")

# Load data
load("Data/le_birth.Rdata")
load("Data/le_change_sf.Rdata")
load("Data/post_prob_sf.Rdata")
load("Data/le_by_decile.Rdata")

# Convert data to sf
le_birth_sf <- st_as_sf(le_birth)

# Function to create maps
make_maps <- function(sex_input, yr_input, measure) {
  
  # LE at birth maps
  if (measure == "Life Expectancy at Birth") {
    
    # Prep data
    d <- le_birth_sf %>% filter(sex == sex_input, years == yr_input) %>%
      mutate(val = round(med,2),
             popup = paste0(round(med,2)," (",round(lci,2),", ",round(uci,2),")"),
             GEOID_str = as.character(GEOID))
    
    # Compute Jenks breaks for LE at birth
    n_breaks <- 5
    breaks <- classIntervals(d$val, n = n_breaks, style = "jenks")$brks
    
    # Color palette 
    pal <- brewer.pal(n_breaks,"Blues")
    
    # Legend title
    legend <- "LE (Years)"
    
    # Polygon fill settings
    scale <- tm_scale_intervals(style = "fixed", 
                                breaks = breaks,
                                label.format = list(text.separator = "to"),
                                values = pal,
                                label.na = "NA") 
    # Change in LE at birth maps
  } else if (measure == "Change in LE") {
    
    # Prep data
    d <- le_change_sf %>% filter(sex == sex_input) %>%
      mutate(val = round(med,2),
             popup = paste0(round(med,2)," (",round(lci,2),", ",round(uci,2),")"),
             GEOID_str = as.character(GEOID))
    
    # Compute Jenks breaks for change in LE at birth
    n_breaks <- 5
    breaks <- classIntervals(d$val, n = n_breaks, style = "jenks")$brks
    
    # Color palette
    pal <- colorRampPalette(c("red","white","green"))(n_breaks)
    
    # Legend title
    legend <- "Change in LE (Years)"
    
    # Polygon fill settings
    scale <- tm_scale_intervals(style = "fixed",
                                breaks = breaks,
                                label.format = list(text.separator = "to"),
                                values = pal,
                                label.na = "NA")
    # Posterior probability maps
  } else {
    
    # Prep data
    d <- post_prob_sf %>% 
      filter(sex == sex_input) %>%
      mutate(val = round(prob_decr,2), 
             popup = paste0(round(prob_decr,1),"%"),
             GEOID_str = as.character(GEOID))
    
    # Color palette
    pal <- brewer.pal(7,"RdBu")[7:1]
    
    # Legend title
    legend <- "Posterior Probability"
    
    # Polygon fill settings
    scale <- tm_scale_intervals(style = "fixed", 
                                breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 25, 75, 90, 95, 100),
                                label.format = list(text.separator = "to"),
                                values = pal,
                                label.na = "NA")
  }

  # Create maps
  tm_shape(d) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "val",
    fill.scale = scale,
    popup.vars = c("GEOID" = "GEOID_str", legend = "popup"),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = legend)
  ) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_layout(
    inner.margins = 0,
    legend.position = c("right","bottom")
  ) +
  tmap_options(show.messages = FALSE)
}

```

### Life Expectancy at Birth

These maps show median life expectancy at birth (and 95% credible intervals) for each census tract in Philadelphia. 

```{r}
#| label: le_maps
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| code-fold: true
#| output: true
#| cache: false

tmap_arrange(
make_maps("Men", "2017-2019", "Life Expectancy at Birth"),
make_maps("Men", "2020-2022", "Life Expectancy at Birth"),
make_maps("Women", "2017-2019", "Life Expectancy at Birth"),
make_maps("Women", "2020-2022", "Life Expectancy at Birth"),
ncol = 2
)
```

### Change in Life Expectancy at Birth

These maps show median change in life expectancy at birth from 2017---2019 to 2020---2022 (and 95% credible intervals) for each census tract in Philadelphia. 

```{r}
#| label: le_change_maps
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| code-fold: true
#| output: true
#| cache: false

tmap_arrange(
make_maps("Men", NULL, "Change in LE"),
make_maps("Women", NULL, "Change in LE"),
ncol = 2
)
```

### Posterior Probability of a Decrease in Life Expectancy at Birth

These maps show the posterior probability of a decrease in life expectancy at birth from 2017---2019 to 2020---2022 for each census tract in Philadelphia. 

```{r}
#| label: post_prob_maps
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| code-fold: true
#| output: true
#| cache: false

tmap_arrange(
make_maps("Men", NULL, "Posterior Probability"),
make_maps("Women", NULL, "Posterior Probability"),
ncol = 2
)
```

## Life Expectancy by Deciles of Median Household Income

```{r}
#| label: decile_plots
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false

# Load highcharter library
library(highcharter)

# Load data
load("Data/le_by_decile.Rdata")
  
# Function to create plots
make_decile_plot_hc <- function(statistic, age_input, yr_input) { 
  
  # Filter data 
  filtered_data <- le_by_decile %>%
    filter(Age == age_input, years == yr_input)
  
  # Select variables based on statistic
  if (statistic == "Mean") { 
    yvar <- "le"
    lci  <- "le_lci"
    uci  <- "le_uci"
    ylab <- "Mean LE"
  } else { 
    yvar <- "sd"
    lci  <- "sd_lci"
    uci  <- "sd_uci"
    ylab <- "SD of LE"
  }
  
  # Text for tooltip
  filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
    mutate(
      tooltip_str = paste0(
        round(.data[[yvar]], 2),
        " (",
        round(.data[[lci]], 2),
        ", ",
        round(.data[[uci]], 2),
        ")"
      )
    )

  # Colors
  colors <- c("Men" = "#1f77b4", "Women" = "#ff7f0e") 
  
  # Create plot using highcharter
  hc <- highchart() |> 
    hc_chart(type = "line") |> 
    hc_title(text = paste0(ylab, " by Income Decile in Philadelphia (", yr_input, ")")) |> 
    hc_xAxis(categories = 1:10, title = list(text = "Income Decile")) |> 
    hc_yAxis(title = list(text = ylab)) |> 
    hc_tooltip(
      shared = TRUE,
      useHTML = TRUE,
      headerFormat = paste0("<b>", ylab, " in Decile {point.x}</b><br>"),      
      pointFormat =
        "<span style='color:{series.color}'>{series.name}</span>: 
         <b>{point.tooltip}</b><br/>"
    ) |> 
    hc_plotOptions( 
      line = list(marker = list(enabled = TRUE)), 
      arearange = list(
        lineWidth = 0,
        enableMouseTracking = FALSE,
        fillOpacity = 0.4,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
      )
    )

  # Plot lines and credible intervals
  for (sx in c("Men", "Women")) {
    
    # Filter data
    d <- filtered_data %>% filter(Sex == sx)
    
    # Update plot
    hc <- hc |>
      # Line (central estimate)
      hc_add_series(
        data = d,
        type = "line",
        hcaes(
          x = decile_income,
          y = .data[[yvar]],
          tooltip = tooltip_str
        ),
        name = sx,
        color = colors[sx]
      ) |>
      # CI ribbon
      hc_add_series(
        data = d,
        type = "arearange",
        hcaes(
          x = decile_income,
          low = .data[[lci]],
          high = .data[[uci]]
        ),
        color = colors[sx],
        showInLegend = FALSE
      )
  }
  hc
}


```

### Mean Life Expectancy at Birth by Income Decile

These plots depict mean life expectancy at birth by deciles of median household income.

```{r}
#| label: le_decile_mean_plots
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| code-fold: true
#| output: true
#| cache: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

make_decile_plot_hc("Mean", 0, "2017-2019")
make_decile_plot_hc("Mean", 0, "2020-2022")

```

```{r}
#| label: le_decile_sd_plots
```
